verdict.rationale: Rootly documents natural-language operation in several places. In Slack, Rootly AI takes commands like "Page the security team, and convert this to a private incident." The mobile app has a conversational Rootly AI agent. The web app has a chat for natural-language incident questions. An official MCP server lets users query incidents, check on-call, and take action from Claude Code, Cursor and similar tools. missing for 10: the web chat is read-only, so it cannot act; the range of Slack NL actions is shown by only one example; no independent or hands-on corroboration that NL commands work reliably.
